Package nl.pim16aap2.lightkeeper.framework

Interface ILightkeeperFramework

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
public interface ILightkeeperFramework extends AutoCloseable
LightKeeper end-to-end test framework entrypoint.

The framework surface is organised into facets, each returned by an accessor: server(), worlds(), bots(), and events().
